about.name: Farhan Hilal
about.intro: Lulusan Sarjana Terapan (D4) Manajemen Keuangan Sektor Publik dari Politeknik Negeri Lhokseumawe dengan fokus keahlian pada akuntansi pemerintahan, tata kelola keuangan daerah, dan operasional perbankan. Memiliki rekam jejak praktis melalui magang 6 bulan di PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk KCS Lhokseumawe, menangani administrasi customer service, verifikasi kartu ATM, berkas KPR, hingga rekonsiliasi transfer dana.
about.introEn: Applied Bachelor (D4) graduate in Public Sector Financial Management from Politeknik Negeri Lhokseumawe, specializing in government accounting, regional fiscal governance, and retail banking operations with a 6-month hands-on internship at PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk.
about.educationEn: Applied Bachelor in Public Sector Financial Management

sma.activitiesEn: Active in Leadership & Student Orgs (Paskibra & PIK-R)
sma.description: Membangun fondasi kuat dalam pemahaman sains, logika matematika, serta kepemimpinan aktif melalui organisasi kepemudaan dan paskibra tingkat kota.
sma.descriptionEn: Built strong foundational knowledge in natural sciences, mathematical logic, and active leadership through youth counseling and city-level flag hoisting squads (Paskibra).

responsibilities: Membantu operasional Customer Service dalam pembukaan buku tabungan baru (Tabungan Batara & iB Syariah) serta kepatuhan prosedur KYC (Know Your Customer).
Menangani proses permintaan pemblokiran kartu ATM nasabah yang hilang/tertelan secara cepat dan akurat dengan verifikasi data keamanan berlapis.
Mendukung verifikasi berkas dan pengarsipan administratif nasabah terkait Kredit Pemilikan Rumah (KPR) sesuai standar tata laksana BTN.
Membantu verifikasi dokumen transaksi deposito nasabah serta menyusun laporan rekonsiliasi transfer dana masuk yang belum terkonfirmasi.
responsibilitiesEn: Supported Customer Service frontliners in new savings account openings (Batara & iB Sharia) in full compliance with Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines.
Processed urgent customer ATM card blocking requests with speed, accuracy, and multi-tier security verification protocols.
Assisted customer dossier verification and administrative archiving for subsidized and commercial KPR housing loan portfolios.
Verified time deposit certificates and compiled daily administrative reconciliation reports for unconfirmed incoming fund transfers.

activities: Memimpin dan merancang Program Desa Binaan untuk pemberdayaan masyarakat lokal.
Mengkoordinasikan kegiatan edukatif Go To School di berbagai sekolah di Aceh.
Menjadi delegasi resmi perwakilan Politeknik Negeri Lhokseumawe pada Forum Nasional FKMPI (Forum Komunikasi Mahasiswa Politeknik se-Indonesia).
Mengelola tim lintas divisi dan memimpin koordinasi agenda strategis eksekutif kampus.
activitiesEn: Spearheaded and designed the Desa Binaan Community Empowerment program for local community development.
Coordinated the Go To School educational outreach initiatives across diverse secondary schools in Aceh.
Served as official institutional delegate representing Politeknik Negeri Lhokseumawe at the National FKMPI Forum.
Managed cross-divisional student executive teams and strategic campus program agendas.

projects.title: Skripsi Riset Ekonometrika
projects.subtitle: Pengaruh Pendapatan Asli Daerah, Belanja Modal, Dana Perimbangan, dan SiLPA terhadap Kinerja Keuangan Pemerintah Daerah di Aceh Tahun 2020–2024
projects.subtitleEn: The Effect of PAD, Capital Expenditure, Balance Funds, and SiLPA on Local Government Financial Performance in Aceh 2020–2024
projects.description: Penelitian ekonometrika komprehensif terhadap 23 Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi Aceh menggunakan regresi data panel (EViews 12), menguji Chow Test, Hausman Test, dan Lagrange Multiplier.
projects.descriptionEn: Comprehensive panel data econometric regression across all 23 regencies and cities in Aceh Province utilizing EViews 12, Chow Test, and Hausman Test diagnostics.

projects.descriptionEn: Academic evaluation of regional budget realization datasets (APBK), fiscal autonomy ratios, and expenditure efficiency indicators across Aceh local governments.
